title: Druski & The Strokes on ‘SNL’: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
summary: Livestream the comedian host and the indie rock band perform on Nov. 7 — watch live online for free.
contentText:

On Saturday (Nov. 7), Saturday Night Live returns with the third episode of season 52. The sketch comedy show taps comedian and influencer Druski to host , while rock band The Strokes serves as musical guest.

Get DirecTV 5-Day Free Trial

This is Druski’s first time hosting, while this would be the fifth appearance for The Strokes as musical guest on SNL .

How to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Nov. 7

- Network: NBC

- Host, Musical Guest: Druski & The Strokes

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Peacock

When Does ‘Saturday Night Live’ Start ?

SNL airs live on Saturday (Nov. 7), with a start time of 11:30 p.m. ET/PT.

What TV Network Features ‘Saturday Night Live’?

In 2026, SNL broadcasts on TV on NBC. Meanwhile, the variety sketch show is available to livestream on Peacock.

Who’s Appearing on ‘Saturday Night Live’ Tonight?

SNL is known for celebrity cameos during the show, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Other artists who have been known to appear at SNL in the past have included Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, Alec Baldwin, Meryl Streep, and Harry Styles.

Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch SNL online, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , also offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
